scope: 21 unchanged raw-fish Cooking-input primary assignments; tags retained and supplemental roles unassessed.

Current SKILLING/raw-food/resources targets are confirmed individually. Acquisition restrictions and secondary bait/quest/offering uses do not erase that direct ordinary raw-input workflow. reviewRecord: Root read all21 raw source subject definitions, direct cooking clauses and competing-use contexts. Rawkarambwan3142 is a Cooking input with both poor and thorough cooking; the edible thorough output requires Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. Other exact rows and37 noexactBinding rows remain unapproved. Root rejected the packet suggestion that rawkarambwan3142 itself is vessel bait: the cited bait is the separate rawkarambwanji3150. Root also read the rawsea turtle395 lyre-offering mechanic and does not adopt the packet claim that competing uses are absent.

cases.title: Raw sardine
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Raw sardines''' are fish that require a [[Fishing]] level of 5 to catch by using a normal [[fishing rod]] on a bait fishing spot, by the sea. [[Fishing bait]] is required in the inventory, one being used for each catch, which yields 20 Fishing experience. Raw sardines may be cooked at level 1 [[Cooking]] to produce cooked [[sardine]]s.
secondaryExcerpts: Raw sardines may be cooked at level 1 [[Cooking]] to produce cooked [[sardine]]s.
cases.rationale: The exact raw fish is a directly documented Cooking input, supporting its current raw-food resource placement. Approval is limited to this primary workflow; other uses and conditional output-state restrictions remain unassessed. It does not assert that every cooked output is edible.

cases.title: Raw salmon
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Raw salmon''' are fish that can be caught with a [[Fishing]] level of 30, granting 70 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into [[salmon]] with a [[Cooking]] level of 25. Players will stop burning salmon unaided at a Cooking level of 58 or 55 when using the [[Lumbridge Castle]] range. Successfully cooking a salmon yields 90 Cooking experience. Raw salmon are caught through fly fishing, which requires a Fishing level of 30, a [[fly fishing rod]], and [[feathers]]. The fish are caught with the lure option at [[Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)|Lure/Bait fishing spots]] found in rivers. Fly fishing trout and salmon is a very common way for players to train Fishing quickly.

cases.title: Raw shark
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Raw sharks''' can be fished with a [[harpoon]] with level 76 [[Fishing]]. They require level 80 [[Cooking]] to cook into [[shark]]s and heal 20 [[Hitpoints]] each. Raw sharks can be caught at many net/harpoon [[Fishing_spot_(big_net,_harpoon)|fishing spots]] with locations including the [[Fishing Guild]], [[Catherby]], [[Burgh de Rott]], [[Rellekka]], [[Iorwerth Camp]], [[Hosidius|East of Hosidius]], [[Jatizso]], [[Isle of Souls]], [[Gwenith]], and [[Salvager Overlook]]. They can be caught by sailing a [[raft]] at sea [[Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon)|north-west of Musa Point]]. Raw sharks can also be caught without using a harpoon at level 96 Fishing and 76 Strength by starting the second part of [[Barbarian Training#Barehanded fishing|barbarian fishing]] with [[Otto Godblessed]]. The rate at which they are caught can be increased with the use of [[shark lure]], but doing so will reduce the experience gained.

cases.title: Raw anglerfish
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Raw anglerfish''' are a type of fish found only in [[Port Piscarilius]] or via [[boat fishing]] nearby. In order to catch this fish, players require level 82 in [[Fishing]], a [[fishing rod]], and either [[sandworms]] or [[diabolic worms]]. Each catch grants 120 Fishing [[experience]] (or 79.2 if using diabolic worms). Anglerfish are located at the bait fishing spot south of [[Tynan's Fishing Supplies]], or they can be caught by boat fishing from any player boat [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Boat_fishing_spot_(anglerfish) slightly north-east] of the Piscarilius foodhall. Anglerfish fishing spots on land have a highly random movement timer, ranging from as little as 8 ticks (4.8 seconds) up to 1000 ticks (approximately 10 minutes), making them considered an unreliable AFK fishing option. However, anglerfish fishing spots at sea do not move and so they are the better option for AFK fishing.
secondaryExcerpts: Cooking anglerfish requires level 84 in [[Cooking]], and gives 230 experience.
